summary: KE Holdings Inc., the Chinese real-estate platform listed in Hong Kong and the US, filed a Form 6-K attaching five Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns covering repurchases of its Class A ordinary shares (HKEX: 02423) between 22 May and early October 2026. Disclosed per-share prices range from HKD 36.08 to HKD 45.01 on the Hong Kong line and USD 5.72 on the US line, with individual daily repurchases of roughly 220,000 to 554,000 shares. Shares bought back are held as treasury but not yet cancelled. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated. What to watch: pace of buybacks, cancellation timing, and treasury-share overhang affecting EPS and index weights.
